name: idc-pdxnet
description: A pan-cancer repository of 5,420 DICOM Slide Microscopy instances from 919 patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and paired parental tumor H&E whole slide images (870 mouse PDX, 49 human progenitor) curated from the NCI PDXNet Consortium. Images have associated genomic, transcriptomic, and clinical metadata, as well as pathologic assessments and, in some cases, detailed pathologic annotations. The original TIFF and SVS images were converted to DICOM SM format. Please see the PDXNet Zenodo page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.

blockingLimitations.statement: IDC serves no clinical table for this collection, so nothing about outcome, stage, treatment or demographics can be read from the repository. Any such variable would have to come from the originating trial or publication. The collection's own supporting_data field nevertheless lists clinical data, so the two disagree.
